evidence.note: translateLevel projects the three flags from one ColorSupportLevel: hasBasic is always true for enabled streams, has256 when level>=2, has16m when level>=3. Disabled is ColorInfo=false, so ColorSupport only stores the implication chain of levels 1-3.
Browser writes only the two implication-chain presets (truecolor all-true; basic hasBasic-only). has16m without has256 is never constructed.

notes: level already exists on the same struct as ColorSupportLevel; the booleans duplicate it.

disqualifier.note: Independent NLP capability flags; Composition unions them bitwise and examples advertise mixed subsets (tokenization true with the rest false). All 2^9 combos are legal advertised surfaces.
Independent annotation-stratum include toggles; dependency parsing is opt-in because it is expensive, not because it excludes POS/lemma/entity. Any subset may be on.
Independent executor controls: cache toggles result-store lookup/write-through; trace is retained for orchestration diagnostics. All 4 combos are legal.
Independent include toggles for optional IDF values vs the document-term matrix; either, both, or neither may be requested.
Independently observed token facts; a token can be punctuation, a stop word, both, or neither.
Independent config toggles for OTLP export vs Effect devtools; examples set both false together and otlpEnabled true alone.
Independent reporter wiring toggles: whether to render the pretty cause vs whether to merge with already registered reporters. All 4 combos are legal.
The four booleans exist to be emitted as MCP readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/idempotentHint/openWorldHint via AiTool annotations; the shape is the MCP tool-annotation wire contract at the kit boundary.

Pagination facts independently derived from pageIndex vs pageCount (first/middle/last/singleton). All 4 flag combos are legal; the coherence filters bind each flag to pageIndex, not to the other flag.
Independent axes: conforms is the SHACL report outcome; truncated records whether the violation list was capped. A result may be conforming or not with or without truncation.
Independent detection inputs: isTTY is stream metadata; sniffFlags chooses whether argv color flags are consulted. All 4 combos are legal heuristics input.
Same independent isTTY vs sniffFlags axes as SupportsColorDecisionInput, carried into the prepared heuristic input. Not a masked union.
